name: hk-landsd-openmap-3d-indoor-map
title: 3D Indoor Map
notes: A set of 3D digital maps show the interior structure of a building or a venue. It includes floors, units, place-of-interest and other indoor map features which supports indoor navigation, indoor spatial analysis, etc.

resources.name: 3D Indoor Map
3D Indoor Map
3D Indoor Map (CSDI Portal)

tc.title: 三維室內地圖
tc.notes: 一套三維數碼地圖顯示建築物或場地的內部結構。它包括樓層、單元、室內網絡、興趣點和其他室內地圖特徵，支持室內導航、室內空間分析等。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-3d-indoor-network
title: 3D Indoor Network
notes: The 3D Indoor Network, a vector type dataset, is derived from various source of data and data collected by field checking.  It is graphical with attribute data that can be accessed, queried and displayed.  It covers the interior of the selected buildings, in which the 3D Indoor Map was created.  It connects to the 3D Pedestrian Network outside the buildings to enable indoor outdoor navigation. Its database scheme aligns with 3D Pedestrian Network.

resources.name: 3D Indoor Network
3D Indoor Network
3D Indoor Network (CSDI Portal)

tc.title: 三維室內路網
tc.notes: 三維室內路網是一個包含不同數據來源和經實地考察收集而成的數據集。它可於圖面上表示，並附有可讀取、查詢和顯示的數據。它覆蓋個別已建有三維室內地圖的樓宇。它與室外的三維行人道路網連接，以促成室內外導航。其相關的數據庫與三維行人道路網的數據庫相同。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-3d-pedestrian-network
title: 3D Pedestrian Network
notes: Pedestrian Network is a set of 3D line features derived from road features and road furnitures from Lands Department and Transport Department.  A number of attibutes are associated with the pedestrian network such as spatially related street names.  Besides, the pedestrian network includes information like wheelchair accessibilty and obstacles to facilitate the digital inclusion for the needy.

resources.name: 3D Pedestrian Network
3D Pedestrian Network
3D Pedestrian Network

tc.title: 三維行人道路網
tc.notes: 三維行人道路網由地政總署和運輸署的道路及道路設施衍生而成。三維行人道路網包含了多項相關特質，如相關的街道名稱等。此外，為配合有特殊需要人士的數位包容，它們加入無障礙通道及障礙物的資訊。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-3d-visualisation-map-individualised-models
title: 3D Visualisation Map (Individualised models)
notes:
The 3D Visualisation Map (Individualised models) are a set of digital data of 3D models featuring geometry models and texture maps to represent the geometrical shape, appearance and position of different types of ground objects, including building, infrastructure, vegetation, waterbody, terrain and generic (others). The dataset covers the whole territory of Hong Kong. 

You can click the link below to access the 3D Visualisation Map
(https://3d.map.gov.hk/).

name: hk-landsd-openmap-5m-grid-dtm
title: Digital Terrain Model (DTM)
notes: The DTM is a digital terrain model of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. It shows the topography of terrain (including non-ground information such as elevated roads and bridges) in 5-metre raster grid with an accuracy of ±5m. If land area is covered by vegetation, the terrain will be depicted by the height of vegetation.

resources.name: Digital Terrain Model (DTM)
Digital Terrain Model (DTM) (CSDI Portal)

tc.title: 數碼地形模型 (DTM)
tc.notes: DTM是香港特別行政區的數碼地形模型。該模型以5米網格格式展示地形(包括非地面資訊，如架空道路及橋樑)，準確度為 ± 5米。如土地被植被遮蓋，該地形將以植被的高度展示。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-aerial-photo-flight-index
title: Aerial Photo Flight Index
notes: The aerial photo flight index shows the aerial photo and flight information, including photo number, shooting position, photo coverage, date of flight, flying height etc., of the aerial photographs taken by Survey and Mapping Office (SMO). There are three file formats, XLS / XLSX, KML and KMZ for download. The file in KML and KMZ file format is geo-referenced to World Geodetic System (WGS84), containing both aerial photo and flight information, while the file in XLS / XLSX file format only contains the aerial photo information.

name: hk-landsd-openmap-coordinates-transformation-api
title: Coordinates Transformation API
notes:
This Application Programming Interface (API) provides instant conversion between HK 1980 Grid Coordinates (Northing and Easting) and WGS84 (ITRF96) Geodetic Coordinates (Latitude and Longitude). The conversion methods, parameters and formulas used in the coordinate conversion tool provided in this API are maintained by the Survey and Mapping Office, Lands Department. It is only applicable for coordinates within Hong Kong.

Users SHOULD NOT use the results for applications requiring precise point positions. Transformation between datums does not improve the accuracy. In most cases, the transformation coordinates would be less accurate, because of the errors in the transformation and projection computation would be added to the results. Please seek advice from professional land surveyors. For enquiry, please contact the Geodetic Survey Section, Survey and Mapping Office, Lands Department.

For details, please refer to User Manual (English Only): http://www.geodetic.gov.hk/transform/tformAPI_manual.pdf

resources.name: Coordinates Transformation API

tc.title: 坐標轉換應用程式界面
tc.notes:
此應用程式界面(API)提供香港1980方格網坐標(北距及東距)及WGS84 (ITRF96參考框架)經緯度之間的即時轉換。此應用程式界面利用之轉換公式，方法，參數及運算程式由地政總署測繪處提供。此工具只適用於香港的坐標範圍。
備註:  不建議用戶使用來自坐標轉換的結果於需要精確位置的應用上。坐標之間的轉換不能提高準確性。 在大多數情況下，坐標轉換會減低精確度，因為結果包括轉換時及投影計算時的誤差。 需要時，請向專業土地測量師尋求意見。如有查詢，請聯絡地政總署測繪處大地測量組。

詳情請參考用戶手冊 (只有英文): http://www.geodetic.gov.hk/transform/tformAPI_manual.pdf

name: hk-landsd-openmap-land-parcel-and-public-utility-number-search-api
title: Land Parcel and Public Utility Number Search API
notes:
Land Parcel and Public Utility Number Search API provides service for application developers to find locations by Land Parcel Number, Public Utility Number, Building Common Spatial Unit ID (Building CSUID), Lot Common Spatial Unit ID (Lot CSUID) and Property Reference Number (PRN) in additional to the existing Location Search API for finding locations by addresses, building names, place names or facility names.

Please note that the PRN searching service is applicable to Lot searching only.

resources.name: Land Parcel and Public Utility Number Search API

tc.title: 「地塊及公用設施號碼搜尋」應用程式界面
tc.notes:
地政總署「地塊及公用設施號碼搜尋」應用程式界面除現有的地址、建築物或大廈名稱、地方名稱或設施名稱搜尋地理位置方式外，為應用程式開發者提供額外支援地塊號碼、公用設施號碼、Building Common Spatial Unit ID (Building CSUID)、Lot Common Spatial Unit ID (Lot CSUID)、物業參考編號(PRN)的位置搜索方法。

請注意，PRN 搜索服務僅適用於地段搜索。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-landsd-building-licence
title: Building Licence
notes: Building Licence is the document issued to indigenous/ eligible villager in the New Territories to build house on his own agricultural land held under the Block Government Lease. The information provided includes location of Building Licence with attribute information such as Building Licence number, licence type, permitted structure height, etc. This dataset is one of the datasets in the Land Parcel Framework Spatial Data Theme.

resources.name: Building Licence

tc.title: 建屋牌照
tc.notes: 建屋牌照是向新界原居/合資格村民在根據集體契約持有的農地上建造房屋而發出的文件。提供的資料包括建屋牌照位置及性質如建屋牌照編號、牌照種類、允許構築物高度等等。該數據集是地塊框架空間數據主題集內的數據集之一。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-landsd-coordinate-reference-system
title: Coordinate Reference System
notes: The Coordinate Reference System maintained by Lands Department includes both horizontal and vertical datums. HK1980 Geodetic Datum and HK1980 Grid System are the horizontal datum while the Hong Kong Principal Datum (HKPD) is the vertical datum.

resources.name: Coordinate Reference System
Coordinate Reference System

tc.title: 坐標參考系統
tc.notes: 地政總署維護的坐標參考系統包括平面基準和高程基準。水平基準包括香港大地基準1980 和 香港1980方格網坐標系統，而高程基準為「香港主水平基準」(HKPD) 。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-landsd-geographic-name
title: Geographic Name
notes: The Place Name database is maintained by Survey and Mapping Office of LandsD. The original source of the Database is based on “A Gazetteer of Place Names” with the first edition published in 1960, containing placename features mapped at 1:25,000. The Database stores and maintains names of settlement (e.g. area, town, village), hydrographic features (e.g. river, channel), and topographic features (e.g. relief).

resources.name: Place Name

tc.title: 地名
tc.notes: 地方名稱數據庫由地政總署測繪處負責備存。數據庫源於1960年出版的第一版《A Gazetteer of Place Names》，其中收錄了在 1：25,000 地圖上的地方名稱。該數據庫備存居住地名稱（例如區域、市鎮、鄉村等）、水文特徵名稱（例如河流、海峽等）和地形特徵名稱（例如地勢等）。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-landsd-government-land-allocation
title: Government Land Allocation (GLA)
notes: Government Land Allocation (GLA) is a site allocated to government bureau/department for projects or use (e.g. treatment plants, service reservoirs, depots, works areas etc.). The information provided includes GLA number, type, allocatee, user type etc. This dataset is one of the datasets in the Land Parcel Framework Spatial Data Theme.

resources.name: Government Land Allocation (GLA)

tc.title: 政府撥地
tc.notes: 政府撥地是撥予政府部門用作政府項目或政府用途(例如污水處理廠、配水庫、倉庫或施工區)的用地。提供的資料包括政府撥地編號、類型、獲撥地者和用途類別等。這個數據集是地塊框架空間數據主題集內的數據集之一。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-road-centreline
title: Road Centreline
notes: The Road Centreline dataset is depicted based on the Land Information System (“LIS”) 1:1000 Topographic dataset and is available as the Street Centre Lines feature class in the iB1000 dataset and Road Centreline in iRG1000 dataset. The usage of the LandsD’s Road Centreline is primarily focused on approximate location query and map annotation labelling. Archives of old Street Name datasets are available at (https://portal.csdi.gov.hk/csdi-webpage/achivedDatasetFileListPage/landsd_rcd_1648633077960_97785).

resources.name: Road Centreline

tc.title: 道路中線
tc.notes: 道路中線數據集衍生自土地信息系統的地形數據集(比例為1:1000)，在iB1000數據集歸類為「街道中線」，在iRG1000數據集則歸類為「道路中線」。地政總署的「道路中線」資料，主要用於查找大概地理位置，並用作地圖註釋標籤，舊街道名稱數據集的存檔可於此連結下載 ( https://portal.csdi.gov.hk/csdi-webpage/achivedDatasetFileListPage/landsd_rcd_1648633077960_97785)。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-satref-raw-data-nmea
title: Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network (SatRef) Network RTK Integrity Monitoring (IM) Data Stream (NMEA Format)
notes: The Network RTK Integrity Monitoring (IM) system comprises three monitoring stations located at Fanling (HKFN), Quarry Bay (HKQT), and Tate’s Cairn (TCHK). These stations continuously monitor the performance of the SatRef Network RTK service by comparing RTK-surveyed coordinates with control coordinates. The real-time data streams of these RTK-surveyed coordinates are disseminated in NMEA format via the Open Data Portal and the CSDI Portal, and can be accessed by means of NTRIP. For more information, please visit (https://www.geodetic.gov.hk/en/satref/imstream.htm).

resources.name: Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network (SatRef) Network  RTK Integrity Monitoring (IM) Data Stream (NMEA Format)

tc.title: 香港衞星定位參考站網(SatRef)之網路實時動態完整性監測數據流(NMEA格式)
tc.notes: 網絡實時動態完整性監測系統由位於粉嶺（HKFN）、鰂魚涌（HKQT）及大老山（TCHK）的三個監測站組成。這些監測站透過比較測量坐標與已知坐標，持續監測 SatRef 網絡實時動態定位服務的表現。這些測量坐標的實時數據流以 NMEA 格式經 開放數據平台 及 空間數據共享平台 發放，用戶可通過 NTRIP 並配以適當設定存取。如欲了解更多詳情，請瀏覽 (https://www.geodetic.gov.hk/tc/satref/imstream.htm)。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-satref-raw-data-rtcm
title: Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network (SatRef) GNSS Raw Data Streams (RTCM Format)
notes: The Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network (SatRef) has been supporting for various applications including high accuracy positioning to public since 2010. The reference stations receive real-time GNSS signals from GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO and BeiDou satellites round-the-clock. For more information, please visit (https://www.geodetic.gov.hk/en/satref/satref.htm).

resources.name: Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network (SatRef) GNSS Raw Data Stream (RTCM Format)

tc.title: 香港衛星定位參考站網(SatRef)之GNSS原始數據流(RTCM格式)
tc.notes: 自2010年起，香港衛星定位參考站網 (SatRef) 一直為各種應用包括高精度定位提供支援。衛星定位參考站全日二十四小時不停接收來自GPS、GLONASS、GALILEO及北斗等全球導航衛星系統的信號。如欲了解更多詳情，請瀏覽 (https://www.geodetic.gov.hk/tc/satref/rawstream.htm)。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-satref-raw-rinex
title: Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network (SatRef) GNSS Raw Data (RINEX Format)
notes: The data of 18 Continuously Operating Reference Stations (CORS) of Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network (SatRef) is disseminated to users via the Receiver Independent Exchange (RINEX) format. In addition, the CORS at Kau Yi Chau operated by Marine Department is also disseminating its RINEX data via our server. For more information, please visit (https://www.geodetic.gov.hk/en/satref/satref.htm).

resources.name: Hong Kong Satellite Positioning Reference Station Network (SatRef) GNSS Raw Data (RINEX Format)

tc.title: 香港衞星定位參考站網 (SatRef) 之GNSS原始數據 (RINEX 格式)
tc.notes: 18個香港衛星定位參考站網（SatRef）連續運行參考站（CORS）數據通過RINEX格式發放給用戶。另外，海事處位於交椅洲的CORS站也透過我們的伺服器發放RINEX數據。如欲了解更多詳情，請瀏覽 (https://www.geodetic.gov.hk/tc/satref/satref.htm)。

name: hk-landsd-openmap-true-digital-orthophoto
title: True Digital Orthophoto (TDOP) Series
notes: True Digital Orthophoto (TDOP) Series is produced from Digital Aerial Photos (UE Version) which are taken at flying height of about 13,000 feet, and processed using Digital Surface Model. The TDOP has an image resolution of 0.25m in terms of ground sample distance per pixel covering the whole territory of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.The TDOP Series is supplied on tile basis and each tile is equivalent to the coverage of the corresponding 1:5000 topographic map tile. It consists of 192 tiles provided in GeoTIFF format including a World file with geo-referencing data in Hong Kong 1980 Grid.

resources.name: True Digital Orthophoto (TDOP) Series

tc.title: 真數碼正射影像圖 (TDOP) 系列
tc.notes: 真數碼正射影像圖 (TDOP) 系列主要採用近期飛行高度13,000 呎拍攝的數碼航空照片（UE 版）及數碼地表模型製作而成的影像地圖。以圖像中每個像素相對地面距離計算，其影像解析度為 0.25 米，覆蓋全香港。TDOP系列是以方格形式提供，每幅方格影像相等於 1:5000 比例地形圖方格的相應覆蓋範圍。全套TDOP共有192 幅，而每幅影像圖以 GeoTiff 格式提供並包含香港 1980 方格網地理定位數據的 world 檔案。

title: Vector Map API
notes: Vector Map API is a XYZ Vector Topographic Map Tile Service which enables application developers to retrieve vector topographic map tiles. With the Vector Map, the map presentation can be further customized by the developer using the Map Presentation Style file.

name: hk-landsd-openmap-vector-map-label-api

title: Fitness Walking Tracks
notes: To encourage the public to engage more in “fitness walking”, the LCSD has designated 34 walking tracks in the 18 districts in the territory. Information on physical fitness and energy consumption is provided on every track for reference. It is hoped that the public will incorporate fitness walking into their daily life. They, particularly the inactive working population and middle-aged, are encouraged to engage in fitness walking for at least 30 minutes a day, making the first stride to a healthy life.
